ScoreRequest.description: Pure scoring. Inputs are the caller's *verified* attributes; unverified signals are ignored.

ScoringInputs.description:
The normalized, VERIFIED attributes the score was computed from. Persisting them lets the app re-score
after an ICP edit as a pure function of stored inputs (no re-research).
ScoringInputs.title: ScoringInputs

TitleCriterion.description:
A target role. Met when the title matches any `keywords` (whole-word, case-insensitive: "cto", "vp of
engineering") OR satisfies every given `seniority`/`function` constraint.
TitleCriterion.title: TitleCriterion
